nav.title: Navigation
nav.rule: One tab, one coffee-vocabulary shape — drawn at 24×24, stroke 1.6. Outlined in ink-mute when inactive, filled in accent when active. This is the master icon family every other set should defer to. Five concepts are drawn; v1 ships four — Globe / Atlas is built and kept here so the family stays whole, but the tab is held back for v2.

duel.title: Coffee Duel types
duel.rule: Each duel type names its subject by re-using the navigation concept vocabulary: the icon tells you what you are about to be quizzed on. Cup / Globe / Route are pulled straight from the shared nav family (window.Icons) — one drawing, one stroke (1.6). Only Tiles and Drop are duel-specific, matched to the same weight.

dict.title: Knowledge marks
dict.rule: One literal line mark per topic, drawn at stroke 1.6 (the shared family weight), interior accents lighter. These serve twice — dictionary categories AND the Path module headers — so each is the most recognisable OBJECT for its subject, never an abstract symbol, and no two topics share a mark.

status.title: Status and feedback
status.rule: Meaning is carried by colour as much as shape: sage = right / solid / learned, berry = wrong / incorrect, accent = anything to act on (current step, needs practice), warn = celebration. Each mark has exactly one job.

action.title: Actions and navigation
action.rule: Workhorse interface glyphs — small chrome marks, not part of the 24×24 concept family, so they keep a lighter 1.4–1.7 range. Ink for primary actions, ink-mute for passive affordances, accent only when the control itself is the primary action.

kinds.title: Content kinds
kinds.rule: Used in the "replay" and "saved" lists to tag what kind of thing a row is. Each mirrors the shape of the activity itself.

marks.name: Cup
marks.label: Today (Learn)
marks.description: The everyday drink → the lessons home. Labelled TODAY in the shipped tab nav; it becomes LEARN only in the merged nav model, where Path folds into it.

marks.name: Route
marks.label: Path
marks.description: A trail of stops → the structured learning journey.

marks.name: Globe
marks.label: Atlas · v2
marks.description: The world → coffee origins & geography. Drawn and in use inside the Atlas screens; the tab itself is deferred to v2.

marks.name: Cards
marks.label: Cards
marks.description: A deck → the collectible knowledge cards.

marks.name: Leaf
marks.label: Profile
marks.description: The coffee plant → you, growing with points.

marks.name: Tiles
marks.label: Taste match
marks.description: Two tiles joined → pairing a flavour to its cause. Duel-specific.

marks.name: Cherry section
marks.label: Processing
marks.description: Seed inside the opened fruit. Duel-specific; same mark as the Processing dictionary category.

marks.name: Beans
marks.label: Beans
marks.description: Two cherries on a stem — the raw fruit.

marks.name: Processing
marks.label: Processing
marks.description: Cherry in section — one cherry on its stem, the seed revealed inside. Neutral across washed / natural / honey; water is not the category.

marks.name: Roasting
marks.label: Roasting
marks.description: Roast curve on its axes — temperature over time, with first crack marked. Heat plus change, and it leaves the flame to the streak.

marks.name: Brewing
marks.label: Brewing
marks.description: Pour-over cone with a drip.

marks.name: Espresso
marks.label: Espresso
marks.description: A demitasse — the concentrated cup.

marks.name: Sensory
marks.label: Sensory
marks.description: Tasting wheel — the flavour wheel, one wedge picked. The words for what you taste, not a mood face.

marks.name: Grind
marks.label: Grind (module)
marks.description: Hand grinder with its crank, burr line across the body. The Grind module’s own mark.

marks.name: Equipment
marks.label: Equipment
marks.description: Gooseneck kettle — the most recognisable tool on the counter. A gear says settings, not coffee gear.

marks.name: Trade
marks.label: Trade
marks.description: Balance scales — what a lot is worth and who gets paid. Exchange arrows read as sync, not trade. Globe stays reserved for geography.

marks.name: Check
marks.label: Correct · Learned
marks.description: Right answer, learned term, completed challenge. Always sage. A finished lesson is NOT a check — its bean node shows how full.

marks.name: Cross
marks.label: Incorrect
marks.description: Wrong answer, in answer review. Always berry.

marks.name: Lock
marks.label: Locked
marks.description: Content not yet unlocked. Always ink-mute at low opacity.

marks.name: Status dot
marks.label: Current / Locked
marks.description: Pill marker — filled = active, hollow = pending, none = locked.

marks.name: Crown
marks.label: Win
marks.description: Awarded to the duel winner. Always warn.

marks.name: Bolt
marks.label: Fastest answer
marks.description: Highlights the quickest response in a duel. Always warn.

marks.name: Bean
marks.label: Points currency
marks.description: The unit of progress. Appears beside every points value.

marks.name: Chevron
marks.label: Drill in
marks.description: Trailing affordance on a tappable row. One shared definition at 70% ink-mute — rows never draw their own.

marks.name: Arrow
marks.label: Direction along a scale
marks.description: Slider endpoints and any labelled range. Shaft plus head, because it states a DIRECTION — Chevron is a head alone and states “more this way”. Same 1.5 stroke as Chevron so the two never clash. Rotate 180° for the left end; never redraw it mirrored.

marks.name: Caret
marks.label: Expand / collapse
marks.description: Accordions, review toggles. Rotates 180° when open.

marks.name: Back
marks.label: Back
marks.description: Returns up a level in a flow. Shared definition, currentColor.

marks.name: Close
marks.label: Close / quit
marks.description: Dismisses a lesson, game or sheet. Shared definition, currentColor.

marks.name: Share
marks.label: Share
marks.description: Opens the native share sheet for a duel invite.

marks.name: Link
marks.label: Copy link
marks.description: The shareable challenge URL.

marks.name: Rematch
marks.label: Run it back
marks.description: Restarts the same duel with a fresh question set.

marks.name: More
marks.label: Overflow
marks.description: Additional share targets / actions.

marks.name: Bookmark
marks.label: Save / favourite
marks.description: Toggles on lessons, terms, cards & games. Filled accent when saved.

marks.name: Gear
marks.label: Settings
marks.description: Top-right entry to Settings from Profile.

marks.name: Duel
marks.label: Coffee Duel entry
marks.description: Crossed coffee-stirrers — the persistent top-right duel button.

marks.name: Module
marks.label: Module
marks.description: A stacked cube — a bundle of lessons.

marks.name: Match
marks.label: Match game
marks.description: Two joined tiles — the pairing game.

marks.name: Quiz
marks.label: Quiz game
marks.description: A target — quick-fire true/false.

marks.name: Flavour
marks.label: Flavour / tasting
marks.description: A spoke wheel — the flavour-wheel game & lessons.

marks.name: Bagpick
marks.label: Blind bag
marks.description: An unlabelled bag with a bean inside — read the sample, name the process.

marks.name: Tastefix
marks.label: Taste fix
marks.description: A cup with a corrective arrow curving back — diagnose and dial in.

marks.name: Slider
marks.label: Calibrate
marks.description: A track with a handle on it — put the value where it belongs.

marks.name: Sequence
marks.label: Sequence
marks.description: Three stops and their rules — put the steps in order.
